name: Aviation Edge
tagline: Global flight, airport, and airline data API for real-time tracking and schedules.
description: Aviation Edge provides aviation data APIs covering real-time flights, airports, airlines, routes, schedules, and historical data. Developers use a free limited tier or paid plans via API key authentication. Endpoints return JSON for flight tracking, airport lookups, and route planning applications.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter (e.g. key=YOUR_API_KEY), self-serve signup on aviation-edge.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Limited free tier; concrete request caps not fully verified from pricing page — confirm on dashboard after signup.
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans available; see aviation-edge.com pricing for current tiers.

use_cases: get real-time status for a flight by IATA number
look up airport details by IATA or ICAO code
get flight schedules for an airport
